Many regretted their years of inaction. But not one would go on the record.

"I've got a family to feed," was the common refrain. (To which my reply was, "What about the women who've spoken out. Don't they need to eat, as well?") 
#MeToo https://t.co/5lbgOjqBIB

"socialised to see women as objects" 

Strongly suggest everyone read this piece by @TraceySpicer as understanding this is a step to stopping the harassment, everywhere, in business, community & in the family unit. #MeToo https://t.co/5lbgOjqBIB

"All that talent wasted, because instead of a hand up, we got a hand on the leg."

I'm so stealing this line from @JacquelineMaley next time I hear some-one say, "But he is so good at..." in relation to sexual harassment #MeToo revelations https://t.co/LK9pnPZb6T
